s: A company stores a static website on Amazon S3. AWS Lambda functions retrieve content from an S3 bucket and serve the content as a website. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) directs incoming traffic to the Lambda functions. An Amazon CloudFront distribution routes requests to the ALB. The company has set up an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate on the HTTPS listener of the ALB. The company needs all users to communicate with the website through HTTPS. HTTP users must not receive an error. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Select THREE.)
o: Configure the ALB with a TCP listener on port 443 for pass through to backend systems.
Create an S3 bucket policy that denies access to the S3 bucket if the aws:SecureTransport request is false.
Configure HTTP to HTTPS redirection on the S3 bucket.
Set the origin protocol policy to HTTPS Only for CloudFront.
Set the viewer protocol policy to HTTPS Only for CloudFront.
Set the viewer protocol policy to Redirect HTTP to HTTPS for CloudFront.
e: To ensure HTTPS-only communication without errors for HTTP users: l HTTP to HTTPS redirect at ALB: Configure the ALB HTTP listener (port 80) with a redirect rule that sends all HTTP requests to HTTPS (port 443). This ensures users who accidentally use HTTP are automatically redirected without errors. l CloudFront HTTPS backend: Configure CloudFront to connect to the ALB using HTTPS only (viewer protocol policy and origin protocol policy set to HTTPS). This encrypts traffic between CloudFront and ALB. l CloudFront ACM certificate: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate in the us-east-1 region (CloudFront requirement) and attach it to the CloudFront distribution for encrypting client-to-CloudFront traffic. l ALB ACM certificate: Already mentioned as existing in the scenario Together, these steps create an all-HTTPS path from users through CloudFront to the ALB, while HTTP users are automatically redirected without receiving errors.
x: HTTP users must not get an error, so the viewer policy must redirect HTTP to HTTPS (F), not 'HTTPS Only' (E), which returns 403. Add HTTPS between CloudFront and the ALB (D) and deny non-TLS access to the bucket (B).
